description: Plan, lint, and optionally apply migrations. POST .../environments/{env}/migrations. migrations is a JSON array of {version,name,up,down?}. Without apply it only plans and lints; with apply true it applies and so requires confirm.

apply.description: Apply after the lint passes (default false)

confirm.description: Must be true to apply this mutation; otherwise the tool returns the request it would send for approval.

name: migrate.run
